title: Signal Garden
summary: A fictional tabletop experience that proposes turning local environmental readings into collaborative garden stories.
problem: Community workshop participants need an approachable way to discuss environmental observations without requiring a deployed sensor network.
verifiedCapabilities: The proposal can use facilitator-provided fictional readings in an offline exercise.
proposals: Participants would arrange fictional readings into a shared seasonal narrative.
A facilitator would export a text recap after the exercise.
assumptions: A 45-minute workshop is sufficient for one round.
openQuestions: Which accessibility accommodations should the exercise prioritize?
completedWork: A fictional brief was authored for proposal drafting.

decisions.rationale: The brief does not establish cloud access or a deployed service.

milestones.name: Concept review
milestones.outcome: Reviewers can trace each proposed behavior to the problem and audience.

milestones.name: Exercise validation
milestones.outcome: A future paper walkthrough records timing and accessibility findings.

risks.risk: Fictional readings may be mistaken for measured data.
risks.mitigation: Label every sample as fictional and avoid real-world conclusions.

submission.body: Signal Garden proposes an offline tabletop workshop in which participants turn explicitly fictional environmental readings into a shared seasonal story. The concept is intended for discussion and validation; no prototype, service, repository, or event submission is claimed.

shortFields.name: Tagline
shortFields.value: Grow a story from fictional signals
